A '''Planetary Defense Platform''' was a type of [[Space station/Legends|space station]] used by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] as part of their defense network over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nod Kartha]] shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
Each Planetary Defense Platform had a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] that could project an energy shield that was highly resistant to attacks. Each station was also armed with four [[Laser/Legends|laser]] turrets and two [[Missile/Legends|missile]] launchers.

==History==
The Trade Federation set up a defense network of Planetary Defense Platforms and [[Orbital Defense Cannon|Planetary Defense Cannons]] in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above Nod Kartha to protect their [[Trihexalon]] factory on the surface. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the combined forces of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] and the [[Mere Resistance]] [[Battle of Nod Kartha|attacked]] with the goal to destroy the factory and prevent the Federation from using the illegal Hex weapon to devastate their [[Karthakk system|system]]. The allied force was able to take out the Defense Cannons but couldn't get past the shields of the Defense Platforms until a [[Death/Legends|dying]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Orsai]] rammed a platform with the damaged [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Kethor]]''. The destruction of a platform caused the shields on the other Defense Platforms to fail, allowing the attackers to destroy two more platforms and thus create a hole in the defense network to reach the surface.
